title: BE cascades role create with Delete but no Edit (cascade integrity)
steps:
1. POST /api/roles with fePermissions=['CUSTOMERS_VIEW', 'CUSTOMERS_DELETE'] (Delete present, Edit absent).
2. Inspect the response status and body.
3. GET /api/roles/{id} for the returned role id and inspect the persisted fePermissions.
expected:
1. The API returns 201 Created (NOT 400).
2. The missing parent permission is auto-added server-side: CUSTOMERS_EDIT is cascaded in (Delete => Edit => View chain; View was already present).
3. Fetching the role back shows the cascaded set (CUSTOMERS_VIEW + CUSTOMERS_EDIT + CUSTOMERS_DELETE); the incomplete Delete-without-Edit bundle is NOT persisted verbatim.
